text:
ryan: Requesting a temporary scan exemption for service account ci-deployer. SAST flagged 2 occurrences of potential string-format SQL in repo-payments (rule SAST-RULE-2083) but these are built via parameterized helper. PR: https://redwood.internal/pr/4987 :eyes:
priya: Can you confirm who can push changes that affect the helper? Is ci-deployer the only bot with merge rights to the release branch?
ryan: Merge permissions: ci-deployer can merge release branches via the release pipeline. Human approvers are release-leads (carol, vish). No other bots have direct merge perms.
tom: We need to check KMS decrypts during the CI window. If this helper ever calls keystore.decrypt or KMS, exemption not allowed until we validate.
audit-bot: Audit query result: https://audit.redwood/internal/queries/qs-2045 -> no kms.decrypt events between 2026-02-12T03:10:00Z and 2026-02-12T03:30:00Z for ci-deployer. md5: 7a1f..
ryan: thanks. I also added a unit test to prove parameters are bound and an integration smoke that exercises the helper. CI: https://ci.redwood/internal/4987/jobs/5
priya: Good. For RBAC change: granting a temporary exemption is functionally equivalent to allowing merges that could mask secret exposure. We require: 1) two engineering approvers (one from owning team, one from security), 2) retention of audit logs (already on), 3) a rollback window note in the release.
infra-bot: Policy check: exemption_duration_max = 72h, approval_count_min = 2. Create a ticket in security-board to record decision.
ryan: Created SEC-3091 with attachments (unit test, CI logs, audit query). Link: https://redwood.internal/security/SEC-3091
security-bot: SEC-3091 assigned to priya. Required approvers: priya, tom. Please add justification and the exact code snippet flagged.
ryan: Flagged snippet: ```js
// payments/helper.js
function sqlForUser(userId) {
  return `SELECT * FROM payments WHERE user_id = ${userId}`
}
// caller uses db.paramWrap(sqlForUser(userId))
```
priya: That snippet looks dangerous out of context. We must show the paramWrap implementation in the ticket to ensure it parameterizes correctly. Also need proof no plaintext secrets appear in the logs.
tom: I'll run a focused DAST smoke against the staging release after merge to confirm no exploitable endpoint opened. Also will run a quick grep for 'decrypt' across the job logs.
audit-bot: KMS audit short summary: no decrypts, two encrypt API calls by build-artifact-bot at 03:05Z. Full raw events uploaded to SEC-3091 (redacted).
priya: Provisional approval granted pending: - commit of paramWrap code to SEC-3091 - CI logs showing parameter binding - DAST smoke post-merge (assign to tom) - exemption duration set to 24h
ryan: Updated SEC-3091 with paramWrap code and CI traces. Exemption_duration: 24h in ticket.
security-bot: Approval recorded: priya (2026-02-12T03:45:00Z). Next approver: tom.
tom: Approved after quick grep and DAST plan. Added note: run DAST smoke (login + payment flow) within 2 hours of merge and report findings. 
priya: Approved. Marking SEC-3091 CLOSED with exemption metadata: service_account=ci-deployer, duration=24h, approvers=[priya,tom], evidence_link=https://redwood.internal/security/SEC-3091/evidence. :lock:
ryan: Will merge now and kick post-merge tasks. Release note will mention suppression + SEC-3091.
infra-bot: Merge performed by ci-deployer at 2026-02-12T03:50:12Z. Post-merge hooks queued.
tom: DAST smoke queued. Job: https://dast.redwood/internal/runs/775
ryan: DAST run passed basic flows, flagged one low-confidence auth redirect on /payments/confirm. I opened a follow-up PR to tighten redirect checks.
priya: Good. I'll snapshot audit logs before exemption expiry and keep them with SEC-3091. After 24h the suppression will auto-revoke per policy.
security-bot: Exemption expiry scheduled: 2026-02-13T03:50:12Z. Reminder will be posted 1h before expiry.
ryan: Thanks all. Learned: we should upstream paramWrap adapters so scanner understands the pattern. Filing follow-up: INFRA-412 to update scanner taint rules.
priya: Agree. Short-term: we've tracked everything and kept the audit trail. Long-term: add explicit marker functions so static analysis can follow parameterization.
security-bot: SEC-3091 archived with evidence bundle. :white_check_mark:
